# Play — Happy Medium

- SudokuPad: [Happy Medium on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Happy Medium on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
f-puzzles has no median clue, so each clue is cosmetic purple text at its outside position, and the whispers are cosmetic
green lines (the face outline is drawn closed). The apps won't enforce either; the rules text covers them. I have not opened
the links in a browser, and I don't know whether every app shows text placed outside the grid. If anything looks off, use
`grid.svg` in this folder as the reference picture.

German whispers: r1c3–r1c4–r1c5–r1c6–r1c7–r2c8–r3c9–r4c9–r5c9–r6c9–r7c9–r8c8–r9c7–r9c6–r9c5–r9c4–r9c3–r8c2–r7c1–r6c1–r5c1–r4c1–r3c1–r2c2 (closed loop); r7c3–r8c4–r8c5–r8c6–r7c7; r3c4–r4c4; r3c6–r4c6.

Median clues: below column 8: 5; below column 3: 5; above column 5: 4; right of row 7: 2; left of row 4: 4.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
